LanguageData.EPR.Title: EPrime's Readouts
LanguageData.EPR.SelectGroupHint: Select or create a group to edit it.
LanguageData.EPR.PoolTip: Add as a pooled entry: one slot showing the combined count of everything in this category
LanguageData.EPR.EnableTip: Show this group in the readout
LanguageData.EPR.RestoreConfirm: Replace ALL groups and thresholds with the default set? This affects every player in multiplayer.
LanguageData.EPR.HelpGroups:
These are your resource display groups. Each group renders as a separate band.
Click the checkmark to toggle visibility or [x] to delete the group.
Add new groups using the name input and Add button.
LanguageData.EPR.HelpResources:
This panel shows in-game items you can display counters for.
You can also build resource pools that summarizes counters for multiple items into a single item. Click the Resource Pools button to toggle what this panel displays.
Click an item to append it to the currently selected group. Drag to manually position where the item should land. Right-click an already assigned item to remove it again.
LanguageData.EPR.HelpEditor:
This panel shows you the tiers of the currently selected group.
A group can have up to three display tiers. A new tier automatically becomes available when the previous tier is non-empty.
Click or drag items from the panel on the right to add them to the selected group.
Click a slot to set display options. Right-click a slot to clear the assignment. Drag items to re-arrange inside or between tiers.
LanguageData.EPR.SearchStorageOnlyTip: When enabled, only counts eligible, non-rotten items in stockpile zones or storage buildings such as shelves. Loose map items elsewhere on the map are excluded. Items carried by pawns, held in inventories or containers, or hidden in unrevealed areas are never counted. Forbidden items are included unless “Ignore forbidden items” is also enabled.
LanguageData.EPR.ReserveForBillsTip: Subtracts the ingredients your outstanding bills still have to consume. A bill only reserves an ingredient it can be satisfied by in exactly one way — "any leather" and similar open choices reserve nothing.
LanguageData.EPR.ReserveForBuildablesTip: Subtracts the materials your blueprints and part-built frames still need. Materials already hauled into a frame are not counted again, and forbidden blueprints are ignored.
LanguageData.EPR.ShowNegativeCountsTip: When planned work needs more than you have, show how far short you are instead of stopping at zero.
LanguageData.EPR.QualityJobsReworkTip: For bills and buildables with a quality target, estimate how many attempts the target will take and reserve for all of them. Rebuilt structures give back the share vanilla refunds when they are deconstructed.
LanguageData.EPR.QualityJobsMissingTip: Requires EPrime's Quality Jobs, which is not installed.
LanguageData.EPR.QualityJobsOutdatedTip: EPrime's Quality Jobs is installed but does not offer the integration this needs. Update it to enable this option.
LanguageData.EPR.HelpPools:
This panel allows you to configure resource pools. A resource pool is a selection of items that you want summarized as a single icon in the readout.
You can only assign pools to tiers by dragging.
Clicking a group selects it and shows the Configure Resource Pool panel, where you can tree-select which items to include in the pool.
LanguageData.EPR.HelpPoolEditor: Tick categories or individual resources to include them. Click a resource's name to use its icon for the pool.
LanguageData.EPR.DeletePoolConfirm: Delete pool "{0}"? Slots using it will be removed from all groups.
LanguageData.EPR.ClipboardEmpty: Clipboard is empty or does not contain a readout export.
LanguageData.EPR.ImportWarning: WARNING: This will REPLACE all current pools, groups, and thresholds. This affects every player in multiplayer.
LanguageData.EPR.DeleteFileConfirm: Delete the file "{0}"? This cannot be undone.
